title: Give truth a chance.
abstract: As a curious undergraduate studying Ayurveda, the first concept that intrigued me was Sushruta's take on foetal sex determination. At the time of conception, if the man's semen is in excess, a male foetus results; if the woman's menstrual blood is in excess, a female foetus results; if semen and menstrual blood are in equal measure, an intersex is formed.
